title: mcp_tool_call_request
description: Request body for POST /v1/mcp/{server}/tools/{tool}. Loosely follows the JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call shape from the MCP HTTP transport spec; the demo subset accepts an `arguments` map plus optional `id` for client correlation.

id.description: Client-supplied correlation id; echoed back on the response.

arguments.description: Tool-specific arguments. Validated per tool inside the handler (the per-tool schemas live under capabilities[].input_schema_ref in the registry entry).
